intro_html: Spinach artichoke dip is the appetizer everybody hovers over until the bowl is scraped. This takes that exact flavor, drops the mayonnaise-heavy base, and builds it into a wild rice casserole with ground turkey underneath. Each serving carries 45 grams of protein and 568 calories for about $3.12 (at everyday cost). Wild rice is what drives the cost, and it also makes it taste like nothing else on the list.
cost_closing_html: About $3.12 a serving (at everyday cost). Wild rice and canned artichoke hearts are both premium items, and they are the two things that make this dish what it is. A wild rice blend cuts the price meaningfully if you want the same flavor for less.
shop_smart: Wild rice is the biggest single cost in this recipe by a wide margin. A wild rice blend costs a fraction as much and still gives you the chew and the nutty flavor.
Canned artichoke hearts in water cost far less than marinated ones in oil, and marinated hearts would fight the cream sauce anyway. Drain and chop them yourself.
Frozen chopped spinach costs a fraction of fresh for the same cooked volume. Wring it bone dry or the casserole will end up watery.
Reduced fat mozzarella in 8 oz bags is the cheapest melting cheese for this job, and this recipe needs nearly two pounds of it, so compare the bag price against a block.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Rinse the wild rice and simmer it in salted water for 40 to 45 minutes until the grains split and are tender but still chewy, then drain it well.
Brown the ground turkey in a large pot over medium-high heat, seasoning it with the Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper as it cooks.
Thaw the frozen chopped spinach and wring it dry in a clean towel. Then wring it again, because this is the step that decides whether the casserole sets or slumps.
Whisk the flour into the cold milk in a jar until smooth, pour it into the pot with the turkey, and cook 5 minutes until it thickens into a sauce.
Off the heat, melt in about two thirds of the shredded mozzarella, then fold in the squeezed spinach, the drained chopped artichoke hearts, and the cooked wild rice.
Spread everything into a greased 9x13 pan and cover with the remaining mozzarella.
Bake at 375F for 30 minutes until bubbling and browned at the edges, then rest 10 minutes before portioning.
portion_html: Weigh the pan, subtract the empty pan weight, and divide by 14. Wild rice settles unevenly, so cut to the scale rather than trusting the look of the squares. Each serving comes to 568 calories and 45 grams of protein.

head.description: Turkey spinach artichoke wild rice casserole meal prep: ground turkey, spinach, and artichoke hearts in a mozzarella cream sauce over wild rice. 568 calories, 45g protein, about $3.12 a serving (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: spinach artichoke casserole, turkey wild rice bake, artichoke heart recipes, high protein casserole, budget meal prep, creamy rice casserole
steps: Simmer the rinsed wild rice in salted water 40 to 45 minutes until the grains split, then drain.
Brown the ground turkey with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Thaw and wring the frozen spinach completely dry.
Whisk flour into cold milk, add to the turkey, and cook 5 minutes until thick, then melt in most of the mozzarella off the heat.
Fold in the spinach, drained chopped artichokes, and wild rice, top with the rest of the cheese, bake at 375F for 30 minutes, rest, and portion into 14 containers.
